frase_gancho.texto: A metropolis raised over caverns of sacred water.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Before you reach the great esplanade, it is worth looking at the ground beneath your feet. In northern Yucatán there are almost no rivers on the surface: rain filters through the limestone, and the water runs underground, surfacing only where the roof of a cave collapsed, forming a cenote. Chichén Itzá grew up beside several of them, especially between the years seven hundred fifty and eleven hundred. These first two stops tell you where you are and how the stage was built. In a few steps you will leave the trees behind and see the Great Leveling.
